data.narrative: Orchestrated 3 parallel execution streams with typed interface contracts across Discovery, Booking, and Payment. Detected subtle enum and timestamp contract violations from a rogue agent at Checkpoint 1, implemented class-transformer DTO serialization fixes, and verified the entire integration end-to-end with zero defects.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified implicit integration requirements including shared DTO schemas, ISO 8601 UTC timestamp conventions, HTTP 409 conflict handling, and uniform error envelopes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Extracted complete typed interfaces and error contracts across all 3 streams in artifacts/contracts/module-06-interface-contracts.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Correctly determined which tickets can execute concurrently and which require strict serialization, ordering work around interface contract stubs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Decoupled Stream B and Stream C using IPaymentGateway stubs and scheduled Stream A and Stream C in parallel while gating Stream B on slot contract availability.

dimension_scores.observation: Anticipated cross-agent contract drift and integration bottlenecks, designing checkpoint sync gates specifically to catch serialization mismatches early.
dimension_scores.evidence: Selected isolated branches with intermediate checkpoint syncs to contain blast radius and prevent rogue agent code from tainting adjacent streams.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored unambiguous interface contracts with explicit field types, HTTP status mappings, and error formats enabling autonomous agent development.
dimension_scores.evidence: Produced artifacts/contracts/module-06-interface-contracts.md detailing ProviderProfileWithSlotsContract, BookingConfirmationContract, and PaymentEscrowResultContract.

dimension_scores.observation: Conducted rapid forensic diffing of rogue agent output, pinpointed both enum casing and unix timestamp violations in under 3 minutes, and applied clean DTO fixes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented root cause, blast radius, and fix options in progress/decomposition/module-06/break-rogue-agent.md and updated code in artifacts/parallel/module-06-agent-output-bundle.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced data flow end-to-end through all parallel agent outputs and verified type and schema compatibility at the runtime boundary.
dimension_scores.evidence: Validated Sarah & Mike booking trace across Stream A, Stream B, and Stream C, verifying slot mutex status updates and exact ISO timestamp serialization.

strengths: Demonstrated exceptional integration engineering by establishing typed contracts and isolated branch sync gates that prevented rogue agent code from contaminating the main codebase.
Rapidly identified and remediated subtle contract serialization divergences (enum casing and Unix timestamp) using structured forensic diffing and class-transformer DTO decorators.
data.recommendation: Carry forward the contract-first discipline into Module 07 to handle sudden requirement changes and mid-build scope adjustments without destabilizing established interfaces.

public_evidence.student_action: Defined typed interface contracts, DTO schemas, and HTTP error envelopes for 3 parallel workstreams.
public_evidence.technical_detail: TypeScript interface contracts, class-validator/class-transformer DTOs, ISO 8601 UTC date formatting, and NestJS error shapes.
public_evidence.ability: Contract-first API design, multi-agent parallel execution coordination, and automated integration gating.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows the candidate can orchestrate multiple parallel engineering teams or autonomous AI agents without suffering from big-bang integration failures.
